_comment: Test plan (user 2026-10-25: tests are built alongside the mod). Each feature needs at least `min` DIFFERENT in-game tests passing whose id starts with `prefix` (SCOPE-TEST pass <id>). A new feature = a new line here in the same change. Never lower a min or remove a line to get a push through. Useleess Carpet: launcher + patch for a 1.12.2 Carpet server; in-game = real servers from the launcher jar (ingame-test.sh, test box). Bulk tests are unit tests in mod/src/test.

features.what: launcher install: download from Mojang, installer deletes itself (install-only + after the server stops), folder left clean, built jar contents, owner's own Mojang jar kept, server jar reused, 0.1.0 folder removed
server from the launcher: boot, VasTech / Kisde / Bullet rules, Redstone Scope loaded, clean stop

double-click installer window (user 2026-10-30): our own start-useleess-carpet.bat made, the owner's scripts never changed, EULA asked, Java 8 found, server started in its own window, installer removed, the made script starts the server

our own Carpet rules: listed, saved, endPortalNoTeleportPlayer, redstoneScopeLogger (listed, off/on, saved), antiNoFall (listed, off = vanilla, on = a no-fall cheat is hurt like an honest fall, honest falls unchanged), litematicaShulkerRestock (listed, off refused, wrong item refused, on moves the stack out of the box), litematicaAccuratePlacement (listed, LU told off / on, off = vanilla, on = stair, trapdoor, gate, lever, repeater + rail unpowered, double chest halves pair, a lever placed on powers what it touches, no change of dirt / wool / iron open / snow layers / blocks already there)

careful break per player (/log carefulBreak [sneak|always]): default needs Sneak, always needs no Sneak, not subscribed = drops on the ground, rule carefulBreak off = ground, the choice is remembered over a server restart

op-made custom recipes (rule customRecipes, /customrecipe): survival op opens the one-window editor, category / paging / anvil search, build + save, crafting works, any order, clear, all recipes (load, overwrite, delete), refused saves, exit / close / disconnect / killed server restore the inventory exactly, no item can leave, non-op and rule-off refused, restart keeps recipes, bad file skipped, recipe type button (crafting table / furnace / brewing stand)
furnace recipes (#7): saved, a real furnace smelts them, vanilla smelting kept, a vanilla clash refused, rule off = none, kept over a restart

brewing stand recipes (#8): bottle cell takes bottles only, saved with the potion type, a real brewing stand brews them, the potion type must match, vanilla brewing kept, a vanilla clash refused, rule off = none, kept over a restart
recipe type button (#7 #8): cycles both ways, each type uses only its own cells, loading a recipe switches to its type

bots that sleep by themselves (#11, /autosleep <bot> on|off): a non-bot refused, on + a bed in reach = the bot goes to bed and the night is skipped, off = stays up, no bed in reach = told + stays up, the choice is remembered over a server restart
#12 crash: a recipe unlocked for a player with no connection is skipped (stays unlocked), the server keeps running
